summary: Crow's nest and camp listed for the 1920s on a Payette NF summit near Warren; sources call it abandoned and in ruins.

facts.status_note: Abandoned; both lookout pages describe ruins

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the summit as a hike-in

corrections.why: Both sources say the site is abandoned with ruins ('Abandoned; ruins.' and 'Abandoned / Ruins'), not gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and the FFLA list spell it Burgdorff; the Idaho Fire Lookouts title and URL spell it Burgdorf. The story uses Burgdorff Summit, the name in the record, and notes the other spelling.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: four sources repeat the same 1920s crow's nest and camp, abandoned and ruins. The 1920s date is decade-only and no abandonment date is given, so no abandonment event is recorded. The brief's status 'gone' is corrected to 'ruins' per both site pages. Idaho Fire Lookouts states no staffing history is documented; nothing is written on staffing. Spelling differs (Burgdorff vs Burgdorf). No photos were found with image URLs. Coordinates in the FFLA list match the brief. A better source would be Kresek's Fire Lookouts of the Northwest or a Payette National Forest lookout history; a University of Idaho catalog item (cccidaho1229) was found but its full text was not located. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story no longer says no source describes what remains, because both site pages describe ruins. The 1920s crow's nest and camp sentence no longer cites the FFLA list, which gives no date or camp.
